long long dp[105][25][11];

void initializeDP(long long dp[][25][11], int size) {
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 11; k++) {
                dp[i][j][k] = -1;
            }
        }
    }
}

long long compute(char arr[], int idx, int prevRem, int val) {
    if (idx == strlen(arr)) {
        return prevRem == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (dp[idx][prevRem][val] != -1) {
        return dp[idx][prevRem][val];
    }
    long long result = 0;
    if (arr[idx] == '_') {
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            if (idx == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
            int newRem = (prevRem * 10 + digit) % 25;
            result += compute(arr, idx + 1, newRem, val);
        }
    } else if (arr[idx] == 'X') {
        if (val != 10) {
            result += compute(arr, idx + 1, (prevRem * 10 + val) % 25, val);
        } else {
            for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
                if (idx == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
                int newRem = (prevRem * 10 + digit) % 25;
                result += compute(arr, idx + 1, newRem, digit);
            }
        }
    } else {
        int digit = arr[idx] - '0';
        result += compute(arr, idx + 1, (prevRem * 10 + digit) % 25, val);
    }
    return dp[idx][prevRem][val] = result;
}
